p1.note: Turkish "zahir olan (ikincisidir)" was ambiguous for the Arabic "وألا تكون وهو الظاهر"; now says the evident view is that it is not tanazu.
TR: false translator note claiming source has «واصل» (source reads «وواصل») removed; EN: invented bracket [Weeping] removed from the 2164 verse
Second paragraph discusses {قالا ربنا} (7:23, printed [الروم: 23]) not 7:25; both readings carry a note

p2.note: TR rendered Makki's «الإِجلالُ والتعظيم والتنزيه» as "ta'zim, tazim ve tenzih" (duplicate, الإجلال lost); now "iclâl (yüceltme), tazim ve tenzih".

p1.note: EN omitted the Arabic of verses 2205-2208 (translation only) and silently normalised «حَرَّ مهما»; restored with note
TR: removed unmarked addition "(vâvdan sonra da nasbedilir)"; EN: "multiplicity of those killed" rendered لتعدد المجال wrongly, now "scope (al-majāl)"
TR verse 2267 dropped the name أبي حباحب (rendered as fireflies); restored Ebû Hubâhib

p2.note: EN rendered «يُسْمِعْ بما لم يُسْمَعِ» (verse 2276) as "he will hear"; the verb is causative, corrected to "he will make heard".

p1.note: Turkish had garbled "lafzatullaha" for للجلالة; fixed to "Celal lafzina".

p2.note: EN rendered Ibn Atiyya's «قومٍ قد جعلوا أمثالاً للمؤمنين» as "made similar to the believers"; now "made examples (amthāl) for the believers".

p1.note: English silently rendered source «الفَرْز والنَّخْس» as "goading and pricking" without noting the source reading; added translator note.

p2.note: EN rendered "وفي الجملة ذِكْرُ كلٍّ منهما" as "in sum each of them is mentioned"; corrected to "the clause contains a reference to each of them".

p1.note: English rendered مجاوز لعليم as "goes beyond"; it means adjacent to (both being intensive forms); Turkish "bitişik" was right.
English rendered «قَوٍّ فعَرْعرا» as a wrong place name (Ghar-ar); corrected to Qaww and ʿArʿar.
Second paragraph (الاجتباء, «هلا اجتمعتها», {إِنْ هذا إِلاَّ إِفْكٌ افتراه}) explains «لَوْلاَ اجْتَبَيْتَهَا» of 7:203, not 7:204; Turkish already carries a translator note.

p2.note: The second paragraph («والاجتباء: افتعال مِنْ جَبَاه» ... Zamakhsharī on «اجتباها») comments on 7:203 لولا اجتبيتها, not 7:204; readings render it faithfully.

p1.note: TR added Garib title for الهروي في عربيته (meaning: on its being Arabic); corrected
TR removed unmarked addition (en-Nehai) after Ibrahim
EN silently blended source misprint لعبارة الأصنام; now with translator note
TR turned "أي: أطلب لكم" into a question with unmarked insertion; corrected
TR rendered الرحم (womb/kinship) as merhamet; corrected to rahim.
English silently corrected the source typo «فأذَّن: تفعَّل مِنْ هذا» to taʾadhdhana; added a Translator's note as the Turkish has.

p2.note: TR wrote [es-Sâffât: 164] in the body where the Arabic has «الصافات: 64»; restored 64 as written with the translator note beside it.

p1.note: TR "ve ondan sonraki ... başkalarının" mistranslated وغيرِه ممن يقول (and others who say); corrected
EN "by his speaking to her" changed بتكليمي إياها (my speaking); corrected
EN omitted the Arabic verse 2193 (translation only); Arabic verse restored
Turkish "Öncekileri sonrakilerine dedi ki" garbled subject; now "Öncekiler sonrakilere". English rendered «ما دعاؤكم...» as "is of no use", not in the source; made literal "what is your calling...".
EN gloss of poem 2227 «مَبارِكَ الجِلادِ» as blessed in battle was unsupported; rendered literally with a marked note.
EN silently changed «لِمَ لا تأتيها» to why should we not do it; now marked with a translator note, and the «إذا» typo also marked.
EN omitted the Arabic of verse 2238; restored
TR added unmarked identifications (Ibnu s-Sikkit, Ibnu l-Enbari) not in the Arabic; removed
English added "(of poetry)" after «ضرورة» (unmarked addition); removed.

p2.note: English made Ḥamza the subject of «ولهذا وافق حمزة في النحل»; it is al-Kisāʾī who agreed with Ḥamza in al-Naḥl. Corrected.

p1.note: Turkish added unmarked glosses: "(helâke)" in the takdir of «سنستدرج الذين كذَّبوا», "(emeklediğinde)" for «دَرَجَ الصبيُّ» (crawling is not walking with short steps), and "[kefene]" for «دَرَجَ الميتَ»; removed.
